description: This source file defines a Spring MVC Controller for managing Customer Option Values in an admin web interface. It includes methods for listing, editing, creating, saving, paging, and removing customer option values, handling form submissions, and returning JSON responses for AJAX calls.

classes.name: CustomerOptionsValueController
classes.description: Spring MVC controller managing customer option values (create, read, update, delete) in the admin interface.

methods.name: displayOptionValues
methods.description: Displays the list page for customer option values.

methods.name: displayOptionValueEdit
methods.description: Displays the edit form for a specific customer option value identified by id.

methods.name: displayOptionValueCreate
methods.description: Prepares the form for creating a new customer option value.

methods.name: displayOption
methods.description: Internal method to prepare the model with option data for create or edit views.

methods.name: saveOption
methods.description: Handles form submission to save or update a customer option value, with validation.

methods.name: pageOptions
methods.description: Provides JSON data for listing customer options with pagination via AJAX.

methods.name: deleteOptionValue
methods.description: Handles AJAX request to delete a customer option value.

methods.name: setMenu
methods.description: Prepares menu context attributes for the view.
